blocks.value: The simplest type of stock chart is a Line Chart. It joins the closing prices of a stock using a continuous line.
Imagine This: Every evening you note down the outside temperature. At the end of the month, you connect all the points with a pencil. You've just created a line chart.
Line charts are easy to understand and are useful for identifying the overall direction of a stock.
If the line steadily moves upward over several months, the stock has generally been increasing in price.
Line charts are perfect for beginners because they clearly show trends without too much detail.
